Section Name: Test Section for Cultura Kaizen (todos los módulos)

Description: While the tools of continuous improvement are obviously important, one thing is certain. If we, as continuous improvement leaders, fail to respect, effectively motivate, and positively influence those around us we will never create strong cultures of kaizen. As such, during this course we will explore the human side of lean in great detail.
Section Name: Test Section for Culture Of Kaizen (All Modules)

Description: La palabra Kaizen se traduce como ‘cambiar para mejorar’. En este curso, ustedes aprenderan qué significa exactamente Kaizen y cómo está ayudando a organizaciones de diferentes rubros tales como manufactura, hospitales, etc. a reducir sus costos e incrementar sus ganancias sin tener que acudir a recortes masivos de personal. De hecho, en este curso verán cómo una empresa logró incrementar sus ganancias netas en casi 25% a pesar de que sus ventas disminuyeron un 25% ese mismo año.
Section Name: Test Section for El Método Kaizen (todos los módulos)

Description: The Just In Time series is a legacy course, presented so that viewers can get an insight into the early days of lean. The main topic of this video series is Kaizen and Just in Time which was the original phrase used to describe what we now call Lean Manufacturing. Throughout this series you'll see many examples of lean principles in action at companies such as Wiremold and Giorgio Foods. You'll also receive an excellent review of topics such as One Piece Flow, Takt Time, U shaped cells, Production Leveling, Kanban, 5S, the Visual Workplace, and Standard Work.

También hablamos de los sistemas Kanban más populares dentro de los ambientes de producción. Y tal vez tanta información y cálculos puedan resultar un poco intimidantes, por lo que les brindamos una calculadora gratuita que les facilitará las cosas. Al final del curso también compartimos con ustedes las 6 reglas de oro y prerrequisitos necesarios para que su sistema Kanban sea efectivo.
Section Name: Test Section for Kanban (todos los módulos)

Description: Mike Wroblewski impartió este entrenamiento en vivo como parte de un seminario en el centro de capacitación de Peterbilt en Denton, Texas. Mike, consultor Lean experimentado, es parte de AGG Academy Consulting. En este curso nos dice por qué Mantenimiento Productivo Total o TPM no es opcional para los pensadores y compañías Lean que dependen de su maquinaria y equipo para satisfacer la demanda del cliente. Además, en este curso Mike explica qué es TPM, las 6 grandes pérdidas y cómo medirlas usando una metrica muy poderosa llamada OEE.

Description: We can say that the entire lean manufacturing system is a result of decades of continuous problem solving by all of the people and companies who have contributed to the development of lean systems. In this course you’ll learn why PDCA is much more than 4 simple steps while also learning how to create and use statistical tools like control charts, Pareto charts, and scatter plots.

Description: El Sistema de Manufactura Esbelta (Lean) es el resultado del trabajo de mucha gente y compañías durate varias decadas. Cada uno de ellos contribuyendo para la continua resolución de problemas hasta lograr lo que hoy conocemos como el Sistema Lean. El curso de Resolución Práctica de Problemas que presentamos en AGG Academy explica detalladamente los 8 pasos de la métodología de Resolución de Problemas usado por grandes practicantes de Lean al rededor del mundo. A lo largo de este curso, ustedes aprenderán por qué el Ciclo PDCA tiene un significado e impacto tan importante en el método de resolución de problemas. Además aprenderán cómo crear y usar herramientas de estadísticas como la Gráfica de control , Diagrama de Pareto, Gráfico de dispersión,etc.
Curriculum Title*: Resolución Práctica de Problemas (todos los módulos)

Description: We can say that the entire lean manufacturing system is a result of decades of continuous problem solving by all of the people and companies who have contributed to the development of lean systems. The AGG Academy Seven Quality Control Tools course explains the exact 7 tools used by quality control experts. No matter if you work in a factory making “widgets” or in a hospital taking care of patients, the concepts taught in this course will forever change the way you use statistical methods to analyze and control quality. In this course you’ll learn the seven key quality control tools while also learning how to create and use statistical tools like control charts, Pareto charts, and scatter plots.

Curriculum ID*: TWI Job Methods_TWI - Job Methods (JM) (All Modules) (AGG)_Library
Description: Job Methods (JM) is the TWI program that focuses on improving work processes and procedures. The purpose of the program is to produce greater quantities of quality products in less time by making the best use of the people, machines, and materials currently available. Like the Job Instruction (JI) and Job Relations (JR) programs, JM uses an easy to follow 4-step method to facilitate these positive changes.This course is best delivered over 5 days with approximately 2 hours of training in each day. The first 3 days include instructional video modules and hands on learning and the last 2 days are focused on hands on learning and application. This is a learn by doing course, so please follow along and engage with the materials.

Its purpose is to get people fully trained and adding value to the organization in the shortest period of time possible while preventing problems that could arise from faulty instruction. The "Facilitator" version of this JI course can be used to prepare for your own 5-day, in person, JI course. You will be able to see a live, 5-day JI course, unfold before your eyes as Ron Pereira and Roger Bilas lead 10 students through the entire 10 hour course. You'll see the students learn and grow throughout the week while also seeing how Roger and Ron help the students work through the process. Once you've completed this facilitator's course you can then use the "Learners" version of this course to conduct your own 5-day JI course.

Description: Job Relations (JR) is a fundamental element of Lean and an important component of TWI. Its purpose is to develop the skill of leading. Used correctly JR will help supervisors, and any other leader of people, avoid problems though proven principles. And if problems do arise JR provides a 4-step process for handling the situation in a fact based, non-emotional, manner. The "Facilitator" version of this JR course can be used to prepare for your own 5-day, in person, JI course. You will be able to see a live, 5-day JR course, unfold before your eyes as Roger Bilas leads 10 students through the entire 10-hour course. You'll see the students learn and grow throughout the week while also seeing how Roger helps the students work through the JR process.
